findings.explanation: Ownership of your work product and materials transfers to the client immediately without being conditioned on full payment, exposing you if the client fails to pay.
findings.suggested_change: Ownership of the Results and Proceeds and Advertising Materials shall transfer to the Client only upon receipt of full payment by the Contractor.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Here is a point I would like to clarify before we proceed: - In the relevant clause, ownership of the work product transfers to the client immediately without being conditioned on full payment, which could pose a risk if payment is delayed; please modify this so that ownership of the Results and Proceeds and Advertising Materials transfers to the client only upon receipt of full payment. Thank you, and I look forward to signing soon.
